name: Security Engineer
description: Build security tools, exploit mitigations, and cryptographic systems. Understand buffer overflows, encryption, secure coding, and vulnerability analysis.
example_snippet:
program SecureWipe:
    import from C the action memset takes handle to bytes, whole number, count produces handle to bytes as secure_set

    keep Password as handle to bytes with room for 64
    put "secret123" into Password

    print the text "Before wipe: " and Password and newline

    # Securely wipe memory
    call secure_set with Password and 0 and 64

    print the text "After wipe: " and Password and newline
    release Password
end program
